text:
Predicates:
City(x) ::: x is a city.
In(x, y) ::: x is in y.
State(x) ::: x is a state.
Home(x, y) ::: x is in y and y is a city in Montana.
Premises:
City(Billings) ∧ In(Billings, Montana) ::: Billings is a city in Montana.
In(Montana, Montana) ::: Montana is a state.
In(Butte, Montana) ∧ In(Helena, Montana) ∧ In(Missoula, Montana) ::: Montana includes the cities of Butte, Helena, and Missoula.
In(WhiteSulphurSprings, Montana) ∧ In(Butte, Montana) ::: White Sulphur Springs and Butte are cities in the same state.
In(Pierre, ¬Montana) ::: The city of Pierre is not in Montana.
∀x (In(x, Butte) → ¬In(x, Pierre)) ::: Any city in Butte is not in Pierre.
Conclusion:
Home(Missoula, Montana) ::: Montana is home to the city of Missoula.
